arguments.command:
cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import datetime as dt

# Case 1: Very large timedelta
huge_td = dt.timedelta(days=999999999)
now = dt.datetime.now()
try:
    date = now - huge_td
except OverflowError as e:
    print('Case 1 error:', e)

# Case 2: Huge seconds integer
big_seconds = int(1e20)
try:
    delta = dt.timedelta(seconds=big_seconds)
    print('Created timedelta with', big_seconds, 'seconds')
except OverflowError as e:
    print('Case 2 error:', e)

# Case 3: Future datetime
future_dt = dt.datetime(9999, 12, 31)
try:
    delta = now - future_dt
    print('Delta from future:', delta)
except OverflowError as e:
    print('Case 3 error:', e)
"
